description.value: You draw upon the collective's memory of polymorphing to refine your current form. You must be polymorphed to Cast this Spell. You increase the speed of your current form, but decrease its padding. For the duration, your Speeds increase by 20 feet for all movement types available to your current form, but you take a -2 circumstance penalty to AC.
